message.content:
This magazine cover illustration features a central portrait of a man from the chest up, rendered in a painterly style. He has short, dark brown hair swept to the side and light brown skin. He is wearing a white collared shirt. Across the lower half of his face, specifically over his mouth and neck, is a thick, dark brown horizontal smudge resembling liquid or mud. Several smaller, circular brown spots are scattered on his white shirt and the background.

The man is positioned centrally, gazing slightly to his left. Large red block letters "TEMPO" span the top width of the cover. Above this, two smaller lines of text in black are separated by a diagonal slash. To the right of the man, bold black text reads "KARENA NILA SETITIK," followed by a paragraph of smaller black text. In the bottom right corner, a barcode and additional small text are present.

Legible text includes: "PEREMPUAN INDONESIA DALAM KEMATIAN KIM JONG-NAM," "WAWANCARA KHUSUS PELAKU PENIPUAN PANDAWA," "TEMPO," "KARENA NILA SETITIK," "Adik ipar Presiden tersangka skandal suap pajak. Duri dalam daging keluarga besar Joko Widodo?," "27 FEBRUARI-5 MARET 2017," "RP 45.000," and numbers around a barcode.
